shots.beat: calm world: the Basin floats, then the storm rolls in
the sky cracks: anticipation, snap zoom, flash, debris
the land rises to meet it

sub.text: And the land rose to meet it.

shots.beat: the egg falls through the crack
far away, the egg sleeps in the shrine

sub.text: Far away, a Kaiju egg sleeps. It remembers every meal.

shots.beat: one hill: they clash, and neither gives

sub.text: One hill. Neither has learned to share.
Feed it, and it fights for you. Corrupt it, and it fights everyone.

shots.beat: your turn: hold the hill; the logo lands where the title's logo sits

sub.text: Hold the hill. Raise the Kaiju.
